primary_boot: Verified owner-key Lineage recovery image now occupies both LNX/boot and SOS/recovery; ordinary startup enters recovery control instead of Android setup. Original physical Android boot backup is retained privately. Android system/data were not erased by this change.
handoff_constraint: Normal LNX boot supplies android.kerneltype=normal and the TSEC client reports a firmware/power error. A standard authenticated adb reboot recovery supplies android.kerneltype=recovery and all seven guarded clients suspend. Enter that measured state before the modern handoff; never weaken its client guards.

watchdog.observed_failure: Native49 ended before its planned reset and the following primary boot reported watchdog.
watchdog.source_behavior: Starting an already running timer does not reprogram its hardware period; this driver has no shutdown callback. An inherited timer configuration discrepancy is an inference, not a measured timer-register comparison.
watchdog.qualified_diagnostic_preparation: Exact root/kernel/driver/device/support checks; standard WDIOC_SETTIMEOUT reprograms the timer, timeout/status/time-left readback precedes READY, descriptor9 remains open across exec, no magic stop byte.

limits: This is secure recovery control for continued development; default standalone Omarchy boot is not implemented.
No general flashing tool or flashable Linux installer is published. Key-bearing images, partition backups, live FDTs, unique USB identities and raw logs stay private.

The modern diagnostics use one CPU, maximum fan,70C cutoff and read-only USB Btrfs without log replay. Networking/input/audio/video/Vulkan and the full enabled board DT remain separate hardware acceptance work.
A software reboot qualification is not a measured physical power-cycle or proof that every stalled-kernel case recovers.
